name: THRUM
author: mohfarzin@users.noreply.github.com
description: THRUM one-container (embedded Postgres+Redis+API+Celery+UI). SECRET_KEY auto-generated. On Wings host run pterodactyl/host-bootstrap-image.sh once, then use image 127.0.0.1:5000/thrum-pterodactyl:latest.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# THRUM egg install — clone GitHub, install Python deps, build React UI.
# Postgres + Redis + SECRET_KEY are handled automatically at startup.
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates gnupg

curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash -
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "USER_UPLOAD set; skipping git clone"
  exit 0
fi

GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS:-https://github.com/MohFarzin/Thrum.git}"
if [[ "${GIT_ADDRESS}" != *.git ]]; then
  GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
fi

if [ -n "${USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo "${GIT_ADDRESS}" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
  if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Existing git repo; pulling"
    git pull --ff-only || true
  else
    echo "/mnt/server is not empty and has no .git; refusing to overwrite"
    exit 10
  fi
else
  if [ -z "${BRANCH:-}" ]; then
    git clone "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
  else
    git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
  fi
fi

bash /mnt/server/pterodactyl/install.sh /mnt/server

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Git repo to clone (default: official THRUM).

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Skip git clone on install if you upload files yourself (1=skip).

variables.name: Allowed Hosts
variables.description: Comma-separated hosts. Default * is fine for first tests.

variables.name: Public Base URL
variables.description: Optional until alerts. Public URL for links.

variables.name: Celery Concurrency
variables.description: Celery worker processes (1–2 on small hosts).
